text:
mira: quick Q on the prompt/prefix cache contract for streaming + function-calls — we're proposing a new response header `x-rw-cache-status`. what should the semantics be for chunked/SSE responses and partial prefix hits? cc @alex @sam

alex: my proposal: `x-rw-cache-status` values = `miss | hit | partial`. `partial` means we served a cached prefix (KV) and then continued generation for the rest. For streaming, emit the header at response start. Add `x-rw-cache-key` (debug only) with a short hex to help correlate hits. keep payload overhead minimal.

sam: agree on values. a few constraints: 1) header must be optional (clients should tolerate missing headers), 2) don't break clients that parse streaming text (so any additional metadata must be in the SSE event layer or in a single JSON metadata frame). also +1 to a `x-rw-cache-suggested-ttl` if useful.

joel: +1. for streaming we probably need an explicit metadata event when a cached prefix was sent vs generated tokens. we could reuse the `event: metadata` SSE convention and send { "cache_status": "partial", "cached_prefix_len": 128 } as the first metadata event. harder with plain chunked responses, but most streaming clients already ignore unknown metadata events.

rachel: function-calling corner: if a function result is returned from cache, we must still run any configured hooks (audit/logging, tracing). also ensure we don't re-run user-visible side effects. cache must store only pure outputs, or mark cached items as "no-side-effect" safe.

alex: impl note: runtime will compute cache_decision early and set `x-rw-cache-status`. For streaming we will add an initial JSON metadata chunk when `stream=true` and `cache_status != miss`. Example (SSE):

```
event: metadata
data: {"cache_status":"partial","cached_prefix_len":64}

```

Also will emit `x-rw-cache-key: ab12ef` when `x-rw-cache-debug: true` header is supplied by client to avoid always computing expensive normalization.

mira: is emitting a structured metadata frame backwards compatible? clients that only concatenate text might see the JSON chunk inline. we need guidance in docs.

sam: test plan: add a naive client test that concatenates all data frames and ensure it still contains valid text and that metadata is ignorable (e.g., metadata separated by `event:` as a preface). add unit/integration tests for both streaming and non-streaming paths.

ci-bot: deploy check for branch `cache/stream-metadata` finished. CI: 102 passed, 3 flaky skipped.

joel: invalidation question: if admin invalidates a prefix mid-stream, inflight streams may have reported `hit` incorrectly. suggestion: add a `x-rw-cache-generation` header that increments on invalidation. cached responses include the generation id; clients or metrics can detect stale-gen mismatches. this avoids post-facto confusion.

rachel: docs note: call out that cache headers are advisory — they describe what happened server-side (optimization), not a semantic guarantee about model output correctness. recommend `Cache-Control` remain tied to user-level caching policy, not internal prefix cache.

mira: action items: 1) alex -> update API spec with header names, example SSE metadata, and backcompat section. 2) sam -> add backcompat tests (naive concatenation, old client). 3) joel -> prototype gen-id header and invalidation event. 4) rachel -> docs blurb + examples for function-calling. PR ping below.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-inference/pull/4123 (WIP) — implements `x-rw-cache-status`, SSE metadata event, and opt-in `x-rw-cache-debug`. @mira @sam PTAL.

mira: I'll review tonight. one nit: prefer lowercase header names in docs (`x-rw-cache-status`) and emphasize clients must be resilient to missing fields. also include sample curl (non-stream):

```
curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello","stream":false}'
```

sam: small suggestion: add an opt-in `x-rw-cache-explain: true` query/header that returns a short JSON explanation when present (only for debugging). don't enable by default.

joel: metrics to add: `cache_prefix_hit_ratio`, `cache_partial_count`, `cache_debug_key_requests`. wire to Console so product can chart.

rachel: acked. I'll draft the docs blurb and examples for both streaming and function-calls, including the "advisory" language.

mira: cool. moving to async review. please add reviewer tags on the PR and add testing checklist to the PR description. :thumbsup:
